items.subject: Single-launch cooperative reduction
items.objective: Using AB-MCTS, investigate the distinct cooperative single-kernel path: resident CTAs compute grid-stride partials, synchronize grid-wide, and one CTA writes the result. The CUDA 12.6.3 guide documents the needed cooperative launch/grid synchronization, but that does not establish effective runtime support or performance on this measured target; validate the actual launch and include host-side setup/query costs in full-program timings. Ensure residency-safe configuration, exact intermediate arithmetic, no reliance on initialized scratch or atomics, and correctness for every valid n (including n=0 if valid). Record unsupported, incorrect, or slower attempts; only return a correctly validated candidate.
